# Capture outgoing username with the other user-selected SMTP fields

Entry 1491 adds the outgoing username to getConfig. Current capture still writes username, socket type and authentication into the existing configuration before returning a copy. A form that displays an edited username must pass that username to discovery; the separate class-copy and incoming-state preservation contracts already have shared lessons. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Account Hub outgoing capture.
